description:
The Mukhyamantri Swavalamban Bhatta Yojana (MSBCCFS) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Rajasthan. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the unemployed youth of the state. 

It focuses on promoting self-employment and entrepreneurship among the youth. 

The benefits include a monthly financial assistance of Rs. 3000 for a period of 2 years. 

Eligible beneficiaries must be residents of Rajasthan. 

They should be aged between 18 to 35 years. 

Applicants must be unemployed and should not be availing of any other government scheme. 

The application process involves submitting an online application through the official government portal. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan. 

The assistance is provided on a monthly basis for the specified duration. 

The scheme encourages youth to develop skills and start their own businesses.
